title: The Temple Is Finished!
traveler_why: Beau is the Traveler with the big, brave heart that keeps going when things get hard, and tonight the builders pick up their tools again and finish the temple: Beau's block tower keeps crashing, but he takes a breath, says a little prayer, and stacks slower and steadier until it stands tall.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because he keeps going when things get hard. In Beau’s world today: Beau was building a tall block tower and it kept toppling — crash! Beau wanted to quit and cry. But he took a breath, said a little prayer, and tried again, stacking slower and steadier, until the tower stood tall. “I didn’t give up!” Just like the people who finished Heavenly Father’s temple, Beau finished the hard thing with Heavenly Father’s help.
